description.value:
One tomoe spins in each eye. Your Sharingan grants you crystalline focus and the first glimpses of your enemy's intent.

You gain a +1 status bonus to initiative rolls when you can see at least one foe, and you gain a +1 status bonus to Perception checks to Sense Motive against creatures whose chakra is flowing visibly — that is, against any creature actively casting a jutsu or maintaining a sustained jutsu.
